prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 88.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Adopt First Account Sign-In Reorder: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet adoption so users build emotional investment before creating or linking an account. (why: Adoption stage drops off significantly (69.9%), and 8 users reported account sync issues when signing in prior to pet creation.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Controls Tutorial Screen: Add an interactive checklist screen at the end of onboarding that demonstrates desktop controls and shortcuts. (why: Multiple support tickets (3 emails) cited confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Pet Recovery Assurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and hint to explicitly reassure users that signing in restores existing pets and cloud data. (why: Top support issue (8 emails) involves users losing pets or resetting progress after logging back in.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Guidance Hint: Add photo quality requirements hint and visual badge to prevent generation errors during custom pet upload. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Tip Carousel: Add an auto-advancing tip carousel and estimated timer to the waiting screen while desktop assets load. (why: Median wait time is 201s with mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off before pet spawns.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Spawn Ready Notification Toggle: Enable desktop notification alerts and direct spawn action button on home intro completion screen. (why: 3 emails reported pet not displaying on desktop or users missing the desktop spawn event.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Split Screen Story Welcome Mascot Layout: Transform introductory story screen into a split layout featuring an animated mascot preview. (why: Reduces high mean time on choose_path (514s) by setting clear visually appealing expectations right away.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in builds emotional hook before account barrier; supported by 8 tickets and high adoption drop-off.
Addresses control confusion at finish step, but adding a full new screen adds effort and potential drop-off.
Low cost copy tweak addressing top support issue regarding pet recovery fears during sign-in.
Low cost hint that reduces photo generation errors during custom pet creation.
Directly targets extreme wait times (201s median / 2336s mean) to keep users engaged during home loading.
Notification toggle re-engages users when long background setup finishes.
High effort redesign for choose_path which already converts well at 88.6% with no direct support tickets.
